描述_EN: this white porcelain stemcup is an example of the so called quanbei, literally 'urging cup', which refers to the fact that the drinker toasts his companions and at the same time urges them to refill their own cups. the results of recent excavations conducted at the sites of the imperial kilns in jingdezhen have shown that this cup was made for the ming court during the reign of the emperor yongle (1403-1424).
描述_ZN: 这个白瓷杯是所谓的泉杯的例子，字面意思是 "敦促杯"，指的是喝酒的人在向同伴敬酒的同时，敦促他们给自己的杯子添水。 最近在景德镇御窑厂遗址进行的发掘结果表明，这个杯子是在永乐皇帝（1403-1424）时期为明朝宫廷制作的。
